title: Grey box: the middle ground people actually use

videos.script: Black box tests from the outside. White box reads every line. Most testers, most of the time, work somewhere in between. {{between}} They know how the system is built. Which parts it has, where it keeps its data, and who reads it. {{map}} This lesson's program places orders, and writes each one to a small database. {{orders}} Order seven tickets, one too many, and the screen says refused. Order none, and it says refused again. Both correct. {{refused}} Then look in the database. Both refused orders are there. {{rows}} And the nightly report adds them up, so a matinée with two seats sold shows nine. {{report}} Nothing on the screen was wrong. The defect was in what the program kept, and who read it. {{kept}} The lesson ends with a map of the system, and three questions to ask at every arrow and every box. {{end}}
